title: Prepare independent bounded comparison and incomplete-coverage reporting

acceptance_criteria.description: Corruption/incomplete input cannot be reported as successful comparison; no offline result claims runtime parity.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Positive and negative schema/comparator/report unit tests at the exact revision, with migration/scope checks.

acceptance_criteria.description: An authorized human reviews this independent comparison oracle before candidate consumption.

handoff: Comparator preparation is independent of candidate implementation and awaits human oracle review.
